name: EXM_AUD_LIST_RULE_SETS
description: This table contains the rules for including employees in expense audit list.

columns.name: AUD_LIST_RULE_SET_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of a specific audit list rule set.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: NAME
columns.description: Audit list rule set name.

columns.name: DESCRIPTION
columns.description: Audit list rule set description.

columns.name: RECEIPT_DELAY_FLAG
columns.description: Audit list rule where a delay in receiving an original receipt package qualifies an individual for audit list membership.

columns.name: RECEIPT_DELAY_DAYS
columns.description: Number of days, beyond which receipt of an original receipt package qualifies an individual for audit list membership.

columns.name: RECEIPT_DELAY_LIST_DAYS
columns.description: Number of days an individual remains on the audit list due to delay in receiving original receipt package for previous expense reports.

columns.name: MONTHLY_TOTAL_FLAG
columns.description: Audit list rule where exceeding an allowable total monthly amount of all expense reports qualifies an individual for audit list membership.

columns.name: MONTHLY_TOTAL_LIMIT
columns.description: Allowable total monthly amount of all expense reports, beyond which an individual qualifies for audit list membership.

columns.name: MONTHLY_TOTAL_LIST_DAYS
columns.description: Number of days an individual remains on the audit list on exceeding the allowable total monthly amount of all expense reports.

columns.name: MONTHLY_TOTAL_CURRENCY_CODE
columns.description: Currency of the allowable total monthly amount of all expense reports, beyond which an individual qualifies for audit list membership.

columns.name: MONTHLY_VIOLATIONS_FLAG
columns.description: Audit list rule where exceeding the allowable number of policy violations per month qualifies an individual for audit list membership.

columns.name: MONTHLY_VIOLATIONS_LIMIT
columns.description: Allowable number of policy violations per month, beyond which an individual qualifies for audit list membership.

columns.name: MONTHLY_VIOLATIONS_LIST_DAYS
columns.description: Number of days an individual remains on the audit list on exceeding the allowable number of policy violations per month.

columns.name: MONTHLY_REPORTS_FLAG
columns.description: Audit list rule where exceeding the allowable number of expense reports per month qualifies an individual for audit list membership.

columns.name: MONTHLY_REPORTS_LIMIT
columns.description: Allowable number of expense reports per month, beyond which an individual qualifies for audit list membership.

columns.name: MONTHLY_REPORTS_LIST_DAYS
columns.description: Number of days an individual remains on the audit list on exceeding the allowable number of expense reports per month.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.
